description: nf-core/hic samplesheet context, aligned to the pinned 2.1.0 schema. Chromosome conformation capture (Hi-C).

digestion.help: Restriction enzyme protocol. REQUIRED unless the library is DNase Hi-C — it determines the restriction/ligation sites.

dnase.help: set true for DNase Hi-C (no digestion protocol)

save_reference.help: keep the built bowtie2 index — worth it, the build is slow

pipeline.name: nf-core/hic
pipeline.core_rule: Columns are sample, fastq_1, fastq_2. Hi-C is inherently paired-end, so fastq_2 should always be populated in practice.

validation_rules: The file consumed by the pipeline must be comma-separated (CSV).
fastq_2 must be populated: Hi-C is paired-end by construction.
Set either `digestion` (hindiii|mboi|dpnii|arima) or `dnase: true` — a run with neither has no restriction model.
Do NOT pass --gtf: hic's schema has no gtf parameter.
notes: Hi-C contact maps. bwt2_index is built from the FASTA when absent and the Luria refs tree has no prebuilt bowtie2 index, so the first run per genome pays a long index build — keep save_reference on.

sources.label: nf-core/hic nextflow_schema.json @ 2.1.0
sources.notes: Authoritative param names, types and defaults for the pinned revision.

sources.label: nf-core/hic assets/schema_input.json @ 2.1.0
sources.notes: Authoritative required/optional samplesheet columns and allowed values.

samplesheet_columns.description: Column-level field dictionary for the nf-core/hic input samplesheet.

sample.description: Custom sample name; repeat across lanes of one library.
sample.validation_hints: Prefer the NExtSEEK D.SEQ UID so results map back to the sample record.

fastq_1.validation_hints: Absolute Luria path, taken from the sample's Link_PrimaryData / File_PrimaryData.

fastq_2.description: Read 2 FASTQ. Hi-C is a paired assay; a blank fastq_2 almost certainly means the wrong files were resolved.
fastq_2.validation_hints: Blank for single-end; keep the header.

report_writer_guidance.purpose: Build an nf-core/hic samplesheet from a resolved NExtSEEK D.SEQ cohort.
population_priority: One row per D.SEQ leaf; sample = the UID.
Both reads must resolve — flag any row where fastq_2 is missing rather than emitting it blank.
Ask the user for the digestion protocol if the sample metadata does not record it.
final_checks: No row has a blank fastq_2.
digestion or dnase has been decided and stated to the user.

required_user_params.name: digestion
required_user_params.definition: The restriction enzyme protocol used to prepare the Hi-C library — it determines the restriction and ligation sites. If this was DNase Hi-C instead of an enzyme digestion, say so and I will set the dnase flag rather than a digestion protocol.
